directive: 会話グラフ、分岐条件、前後の返答を読んで、日本語版ゲームの自然な台詞として執筆する。
translation_policy: F:\Games\Radiophobia 3\Translate\Radiophobia 3 会話グラフ翻訳方針.md

entries.JA_new: よう……ストレロク、こんにちは。

entries.EN: Who the hell are you?! How do you know I am Strelok?
entries.JA_current: Who the hell are you?! How do you know I am Strelok?
entries.JA_new: お前、何者だ？ どうして俺がストレロクだと知ってる？

entries.EN: He-he... Call me the "Dark Dealer". I know all about everything. I used to dwell in the hotel, right by your room 26. And now I've got a separate flat, as you can see... With an amazing view of the city...
entries.JA_current: He-he... Call me the "Dark Dealer". I know all about everything. I used to dwell in the hotel, right by your room 26. And now I've got a separate flat, as you can see... With an amazing view of the city...
entries.JA_new: へへ……「ダーク・ディーラー」とでも呼んでくれ。何でも知ってる男さ。前はホテルに住んでいて、あんたの26号室のすぐ隣にいた。今は見てのとおり、別の部屋を構えてる。街を一望できる最高の眺め付きだ……

entries.EN: An odd guy you are... You even know about room 26... But we may have met before... Before I ended up in the "Death Truck"...
entries.JA_current: An odd guy you are... You even know about room 26... But we may have met before... Before I ended up in the "Death Truck"...
entries.JA_new: 妙な奴だな……26号室のことまで知ってるとは。でも、どこかで会った気もする……俺が「死のトラック」に乗せられる前に……

entries.EN: Well... Let's say... Mmm, yeah, let's say that we have met before. One way or another, had I been your enemy, I would have shot you dead long ago. Therefore, you don't need to worry. I've decided to establish a store here, in Pripyat. A trading post in the Center of the Zone will come in quite handy for stalkers now. I am also on the lookout for capable people to take care of a few jobs for me... Not for the faint of heart, this is the big leagues, none of the schoolboy shit like at the Cordon, He-he... So, lets cut out the chit-chat and get to business!

entries.JA_new: そうだな……まあ……会ったことがある、と言っておこう。いずれにせよ、敵ならとっくに撃ち殺してる。心配はいらないさ。プリピャチに店を構えることにしたんだ。ゾーンの中心に商店があれば、ストーカーには便利だろ。腕の立つ連中に頼みたい仕事もいくつかある……腰抜けには無理な、本物の大仕事さ。コルドンのガキ向けの仕事とは訳が違う。へへ……おしゃべりはここまで。そろそろ本題に入ろうか！
